decisions.head: abdominal
decisions.reason: Wiktionary explicitly identifies the noun plural of abdominal; WordNet's noun sense identifies the abdominal muscles. This resolves the plural identity gap and fits the existing anatomy anchor; no synonym edge or sentence example is approved.

decisions.head: boot
decisions.reason: The exact Wiktionary noun-plural relation and WordNet footwear sense resolve the earlier slang/historical mismatch. Appropriate for the TOEIC footwear anchor; retain the plural identity and do not release unrelated senses or edges.

decisions.head: account holder
decisions.reason: Wiktionary explicitly records the closed form as an alternative of account holder and defines the latter as someone with an account, including a bank account. This fits the Business depositor context without claiming the two are exact synonyms.

decisions.head: business day
decisions.reason: The exact spaced Wiktionary headword defines a day on which business is conducted. It confirms the historical space-loss repair and TOEIC working-day context; stable ID is preserved and no universal Monday-to-Friday equivalence is asserted.

decisions.head: antiquity
decisions.reason: Wiktionary's explicit noun-plural relation joins WordNet's concrete artifact-surviving-from-the-past sense, not the abstract historical-period or oldness senses. This resolves the identity gap for the Academic archaeology anchor.
